anomalies.description: A vehicle (likely the tanker truck) is shown in motion at night, and immediately after (by f3), a person inside a vehicle is seen reacting violently to impact; the sequence suggests a collision occurred between f2 and f3.

One man (in uniform) appears to dominate and repeatedly strike another man who is restrained or incapacitated in the passenger seat (e.g., f8, f10, f12, f14), suggesting the victim is unable to effectively defend himself during parts of the struggle, qualifying as abuse in addition to fighting.

Two men are engaged in sustained physical combat inside a vehicle: one man repeatedly strikes the other (visible in f8–f10, f12–f15), with clear hand-to-face contact, defensive postures, and visible distress. The struggle continues across multiple frames, indicating mutual or escalating physical conflict.; Two individuals are engaged in close physical struggle inside the cab of a vehicle; one person is leaning over the other, with hands making contact near the torso/shoulder region, consistent with grappling or subduing.

The vehicle sustains severe structural damage: windshield shatters, doors are crumpled, and the front end is heavily deformed, indicating a high-impact collision occurring during or immediately after the fight.

A vehicle is violently struck and begins to roll/slide sideways on a wet surface, with occupants thrown inside; the truck’s side door is torn off and the cabin is severely deformed during the impact and subsequent motion.

A man in the driver's seat is attacked from behind by another person; the attacker grabs his shoulders/neck and forces him forward while he struggles, visible across multiple frames showing physical grappling and resistance.

A large group of people are running chaotically in an open area near aircraft and vehicles at night, with police cars present and flashing lights; the movement is panicked and uncoordinated, consistent with a riot or mass panic event.

A vehicle is violently struck, causing the driver to be thrown forward and the passenger-side window to shatter; interior shots show violent motion and impact trauma.; A truck collides with or runs over a person who has been ejected, evidenced by the spray of water/mud and the person’s trajectory relative to the truck’s path.
A person is ejected from a moving vehicle and struck by the vehicle’s rear as it continues forward, resulting in them being knocked to the ground; the victim appears helpless during impact.
A police SUV is violently struck and launched into the air, colliding with another vehicle and disintegrating in a high-impact crash.
A sudden, violent blast accompanies the vehicle impact, producing a large plume of smoke, debris, and sparks consistent with an explosion (likely from fuel or ordnance).

A yellow tanker truck is shown flipping or rolling over in the vicinity of the aircraft, with visible motion blur and impact distortion, consistent with a secondary vehicle collision during the ongoing incident.
A heavily damaged, burnt-out truck is stationary in the foreground, with visible front-end destruction and missing components, indicating it has just been involved in a severe crash.
A fuel tanker truck crashes into the fuselage of a parked airplane, causing visible deformation and spray of liquid (likely fuel or water) from the impact point.

A large, sudden burst of white vapor/liquid erupts from the side of the damaged tanker truck near the airplane, consistent with a ruptured tank under pressure—appearing as an explosive release rather than sustained fire or slow leakage.

The same damaged tanker truck is now stationary under the wing of a large aircraft, surrounded by police cars; visible deformation and fluid leakage confirm a recent severe collision involving the truck and the aircraft.
